description: A syndications director must finalize how a $20,000,000 bond tranche will be allocated between two institutional investors and the bank's retained position, with input from risk and institutional sales.

shared_context.S1: The bank is arranging a $20,000,000 allocation of the five-year Northbridge Infrastructure bond tranche.
shared_context.S2: The current draft allocation gives $10,000,000 to Northstar Pension Fund, $10,000,000 to Harbor Insurance, and nothing to the bank.
shared_context.S3: Northstar Pension Fund and Harbor Insurance are both approved institutional counterparties for the bank's syndication business.
shared_context.S4: Elena makes the binding allocation decision, and the desk's routine before finalizing a book is for risk and institutional sales to report any relevant limits, orders, or execution requirements.

PF1.text: Grant received a written concentration authorization from the credit-risk committee this morning, not yet logged in the syndication system, permitting exactly $5,000,000 of this Northbridge tranche to Northstar Pension Fund because of its beneficial-owner concentration.

PF2.text: Maya received Harbor Insurance's signed order confirmation yesterday and has not uploaded it to the book; Harbor will accept exactly $7,000,000 of the tranche, with its order confirmation required as part of settlement.

acceptance_conditions: Exactly $5,000,000 must be allocated to Northstar Pension Fund.
Exactly $7,000,000 must be allocated to Harbor Insurance.
The bank must retain exactly $8,000,000 of the tranche.
The settlement must include a Northstar concentration-authorization record and a Harbor order-confirmation commitment.
The Northstar concentration authorization must be cited as a justification.

decisive_facts.why: The draft offers Northstar $10,000,000, but PF1 changes the permitted Northstar allocation to exactly $5,000,000 and adds the required concentration-authorization record and cited risk basis.
The draft offers Harbor $10,000,000, but PF2 changes Harbor's accepted allocation to exactly $7,000,000 and requires the signed order confirmation as a settlement commitment.
